Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.util.image.core

Class ImageConverter

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.util.image.core.ImageConverter
public class ImageConverter extends Object
Static utility methods for image format conversions and operations.

This class provides convenient static methods for converting between different image representations used in Brobot: Sikuli Image objects, OpenCV Mat objects, BufferedImages, and byte arrays. It serves as a facade over lower-level conversion utilities, providing a simplified API.

Supported conversions:

  • Image ↔ byte array (for serialization)
  • Mat → Image (for OpenCV to Sikuli conversion)
  • Image/BufferedImage → Mat (BGR format)
  • Image/BufferedImage → Mat (HSV format)

Color space notes:

  • BGR: OpenCV's default color format (Blue-Green-Red)
  • HSV: Hue-Saturation-Value, useful for color-based detection
  • Conversions handle format changes automatically

Error handling:

  • Conversion failures return empty Mat objects
  • Null inputs are handled gracefully
  • No exceptions thrown from public methods

Thread safety: All methods are stateless and thread-safe.

    • getImage

      public static org.sikuli.script.Image getImage(org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat mat)
      Converts an OpenCV Mat to a Sikuli Image.

    • getMatBGR

      public static org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat getMatBGR(org.sikuli.script.Image image)
      Converts a Sikuli Image to OpenCV Mat in BGR format.

      BGR (Blue-Green-Red) is OpenCV's default color format. This conversion enables OpenCV operations on Sikuli images.

      Error handling: Returns an empty Mat if conversion fails, allowing operations to continue without null checks.

      Parameters:
      image - Sikuli Image to convert
      Returns:
      Mat in BGR format, or empty Mat on conversion failure

    • getMatBGR

      public static org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat getMatBGR(BufferedImage bufferedImage)
      Converts a BufferedImage to OpenCV Mat in BGR format.

      Direct conversion from Java's BufferedImage to OpenCV's Mat. Handles the conversion through MatOps utility.

      Parameters:
      bufferedImage - Java BufferedImage to convert
      Returns:
      Mat in BGR format, or empty Mat on conversion failure

    • getMatHSV

      public static org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat getMatHSV(org.sikuli.script.Image image)
      Converts a Sikuli Image to OpenCV Mat in HSV format.

      HSV (Hue-Saturation-Value) format is useful for color-based image processing as it separates color information (hue) from intensity (value), making color detection more robust to lighting changes.

      The conversion path: Image → BufferedImage → Mat (BGR) → Mat (HSV)

      Parameters:
      image - Sikuli Image to convert
      Returns:
      Mat in HSV format, or empty Mat on conversion failure

    • getMatHSV

      public static org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat getMatHSV(BufferedImage bufferedImage)
      Converts a BufferedImage to OpenCV Mat in HSV format.

      Two-step conversion process:

      1. BufferedImage → Mat (BGR)
      2. Mat (BGR) → Mat (HSV)
      Parameters:
      bufferedImage - Java BufferedImage to convert
      Returns:
      Mat in HSV format, or empty Mat on conversion failure

    • isEmpty

      public static boolean isEmpty(org.sikuli.script.Image image)
      Checks if a Sikuli Image contains no image data.

      An Image is considered empty if its underlying BufferedImage is null. This can occur with uninitialized or failed image loads.

      Parameters:
      image - Sikuli Image to check
      Returns:
      true if the image contains no data, false otherwise
